name: TrimText
label: Trim Text
description: Removes specified characters from the start, end, or both ends of a text string.

fields.name: OriginalText
fields.label: Original Text
fields.description: The original text from which characters will be trimmed.

fields.name: TrimMode
fields.label: Trim Mode
fields.description: Specifies whether to trim characters from the beginning, end, or both sides of the text.

selectOptions.label: Whitespace Characters from the Beginning
selectOptions.description: Trims specified characters from the start of the text.

selectOptions.label: Whitespace Characters from the End
selectOptions.description: Trims specified characters from the end of the text.

selectOptions.label: Whitespace Characters from Both Ends
selectOptions.description: Trims specified characters from both ends of the text.

fields.name: CharactersToTrim
fields.label: What to Trim
fields.description: A string containing the characters to remove. Leave empty to trim only whitespace (space, tab, newline).
